subject.title: Interactive parity with the Codex runtime: ask-user-question · plan mode · goal mode — the roadmap

question: Should OpenClaw accept structured questions, plan mode, and goal continuation as core interaction primitives, or require a narrower plugin/API route first?
rationale: The request adds broad runtime, gateway, channel, UI, Codex-bridge, and configuration behavior, and current main only provides partial primitives; automation cannot choose the product boundary safely.

options.title: Review and split the linked PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102261 as the proposal vehicle, then ask for smaller landing slices around questions, plan mode, and goal continuation.

options.title: Route through plugin/API seams
options.body: Keep the issue open as a design hub but require generic plugin or SDK hooks before core Plan/Goal behavior lands.

options.title: Reject core parity for now
options.body: Close the roadmap only if maintainers decide these interaction modes are out of current OpenClaw scope.

recommendation.title: Review and split the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102261 as the proposal vehicle, then ask for smaller landing slices around questions, plan mode, and goal continuation.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the best available current-main routing candidate from recent merged history on the relevant Codex, tool, and goal surfaces.
